scenes.text: New to lifting? Stop wasting your fucking time on tiny moves.
Kickbacks, wrist curls, forty fucking sets a day. Months later, same exact body.
Start with the big lifts. Squat, deadlift, bench and row. They hit a fucking ton of muscle at once.
One press works your shoulders, arms and core. Compounds first, the small fucking stuff last.
Build the base first. That's how beginners actually fucking grow.

caption: New to lifting? Skip the endless tiny exercises. Build your workouts around squats, deadlifts, bench presses, rows and overhead presses, then add small isolation moves at the end if you have time. Save this for your next gym day.
tiktok_title: New to lifting? Stop doing tiny moves.
